jobs.description:
Texas Health and Human Services is seeking a Security Officer II for San Antonio, TX. You will monitor alarms, conduct patrols, manage access, and respond to emergencies to ensure a safe environment for patients, staff and visitors.

The role requires communication skills, knowledge of security procedures, and CPR certification. Regular shifts include nights and possible overtime with state hospital duties at San Antonio State Hospital.
